cases.name: For the Ancestors
cases.text:
Choose a creature type. Look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal any number of cards of the chosen type from among them and put the revealed cards into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
Flashback {3}{G}

cases.name: Sapphire Test
cases.text:
Choose a creature type. Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal any number of cards of the chosen type from among them and put the revealed cards into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
Flashback {3}{G}

cases.name: Amber Test

cases.name: Ivory Test
cases.text:
Choose a creature type. Look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal any number of cards of the chosen type from among them and put the revealed cards into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
Flashback {3}{G}

cases.name: Copper Test
cases.text:
Choose a creature type. Look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal any number of cards of the unchosen type from among them and put the revealed cards into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
Flashback {3}{G}
